findings.title: test
findings.text: This assertion cannot fail: the gate's headline is always `# Release gate: {applying} applying claim(s), {undecided} undecided (an undecided claim is never treated as absent)` (`src/gate.rs`), so `contains("undecided")` is true even for `0 undecided` — the very case this negative-direction test exists to reject. Pin the mechanism the doc describes instead: the `dependencies_decided` policy refusing (REQ-0009 -> REQ-0008 undecided), or the measured count `16 applying claim(s), 5 undecided`.
